There is लोप-substitution (elision) of the व् and य् when followed by any consonant except य्।

Terms: धातुपाठ

The पु of the विकरण उ and श्नु when not preceded by a conjunct consonant, may be elided optionally before a personal affix beginning with म् or व्।

Terms: कित् and ङित्

The final of the अङ्ग (stem) of हा (जुहोत्यादिगणः (3rd Conjugation)) is elided before an affix beginning with य् being a सार्वधातुक कित् or ङित् affix.

Terms: कित् and ङित्

In the छन्दस् (Vedas) the त of the आत्मनेपद personal ending is elided.

Terms: छन्दस् substitution

The penultimate vowel in the Causative अङ्ग (stem) पा 'to drink' is elided in the Aorist and for the vowel of the reduplicate there is substituted long ई।

Terms: Aorist shortening

When however किम् is not added in asking such a question, the finite verb may optionally retain its accent.

Terms: Accent

व् and य् preceded by अ or आ and the end of a पद are elided before an अश् letter (vowels and soft-consonants) according the opinion of शाकल्य।

Terms: व् and य् elision
